QuestInfo.name: [Hilla] The Mystery Potion
QuestInfo.0: You fought with mysterious soldiers. Your best guess from their conversation is that they are #bQueen Areda#k's forces. The potion is on Azwan Lower Floor 2.\r\n\r\nUse the #bportal on the right side#k of the Azwan Refugee Zone to get there.
QuestInfo.1: You fought with mysterious soldiers and got a mysterious potion. Your best guess from their conversation is that they are #bQueen Areda#k's forces. \r\n\r\nHurry back and report to #bMedina#k.
QuestInfo.2:
The loss of beauty across this fair world so saddens me. I have in my possession the power of immortality, which I shall grant to only the most beautiful souls.   
                                                  #b - Hilla - #k

Could it really be the #belixir of everlasting youth#k? Medina seemed unmoved, and said she would study what it is made of.

0.msg: This potion from the soldiers... It's marked with #bancient Azwan writings#k. I should head back to Medina with this.
Maybe I should take another look around.

1.msg: (You explain what happened and show her the #bpotion#k.)

2.msg: I can sense Hilla's evil energy within this potion. She must have made this with her powers. The inscription says...

3.msg: The loss of beauty across this fair world so saddens me. I have in my possession the power of immortality, which I shall grant to only the most beautiful souls.   \r\n                                                  #b - Hilla - #k

5.msg: We can't be sure it's not a hoax.\r\nI must study its components. Could you wait? It may take some time.
